# Domain Docs

This repository uses a single-context layout:
`GLOSSARY.md` at the root and architecture decisions in `docs/adr/`.

## Before exploring

Read the root `GLOSSARY.md` and any ADRs in `docs/adr/` relevant
to the area being explored.

If either is absent, proceed silently. The domain-modeling skill
creates domain documentation when terms or decisions are resolved.

## Vocabulary

Use glossary terms in issue titles, proposals, hypotheses, and tests.
Respect explicitly avoided synonyms.

When a needed concept is missing, reconsider whether it belongs
in the project's language; record real gaps for domain-modeling.

## Decisions

Surface any conflict with an existing ADR explicitly, naming
the ADR and explaining why the decision should be reconsidered.
